name: dsfd_capt_x8_dual

job.purpose: Native SS structural repair: exact pointer-full/hold-ready Boolean reductions; same-epoch local16bit onehot read selectors; complete per-row controller hierarchy with independent reset copies sampled at the existing reset edge; local8bit hold-store enable cones; complemented forward shadow/write-pointer and write-state samplers with original positive reverse read-state sampler. No extra data, valid, reset or transaction cycle and unchanged68 parent roots/assigned123.12x136.08 outline. Prior source-bound placed experiments repair both same-domainSS cones but expose crossing gaps. Corrected first-CTS dual-domain IO rebind applied after tree; actual compensated SS/FF remains required before native qualification. Local-mode state encoding DOWN00/WAIT01/RUN11 exposes peer-UP and RUN bits directly, removing state equality decode from the measured remaining core enable cone. Default mode retains its prior encoding; only legal internal state transitions are generated. Local onehot write-bank selectors reset to bank0 and rotate on the same accepted row as the original binary hw; no data or valid stage is added. Width8 reduces per-enable fanout; default mode stays unchanged.
